front: Prepare to help, then use your reaction to boost an ally's check or attack. Your own check sets the size of the bonus.
back:
Prepare first (usually an action on your turn) and tell the GM how you help. Then attempt a check, typically DC 15 (GM may adjust).
Crit Success: ally gets +2 circumstance bonus (+3 if you're master in the check, +4 if legendary).
Success: +1 circumstance bonus.
Crit Failure: ally gets -1 circumstance penalty.
